cards.claim: Eduardo Sommella worked for the University of Navarre.
cards.quote: The University of Navarre's imposing stone façade loomed ahead, its Gothic spires reaching towards the sky like outstretched arms. Eduardo had always been drawn to the intersection of faith and science, and the University of Navarre, with its rich history and commitment to Catholic values, had become a beacon for him. As a pharmaceutical chemist, he had spent years researching innovative treatments for rare diseases, and the university's cutting-edge facilities and esteemed faculty had proven the perfect environment for his work.

cards.claim: Eduardo Sommella was a member of the faculty at the University of Naples Federico II from 2010 to 2017.
cards.quote: A university spokesperson confirmed that Sommella was a member of the faculty from 2010 to 2017, during which time he taught courses in pharmaceutical chemistry and supervised numerous graduate students.
